headers.access-control-allow-methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS
headers.access-control-expose-headers: X-CPA-TRACE-ID, X-CPA-VERSION, X-CPA-COMMIT, X-CPA-BUILD-DATE, X-CPA-SUPPORT-PLUGIN, X-CPA-HOME-VERSION, X-CPA-HOME-BUILD-DATE, X-SERVER-VERSION, X-SERVER-BUILD-DATE, Location, Retry-After, X-Request-Id, OpenAI-Request-Id

body.value:
host: "127.0.0.1"
port: 38922
auth-dir: "<work>/mgmt.config.yaml_v0/auth"
api-keys:
  - "e2e-client-key"
  - "e2e-client-key-2"
remote-management:
  allow-remote: false
  secret-key: "<bcrypt>"
  disable-control-panel: true
request-retry: 2
max-retry-credentials: 0
max-retry-interval: 0
force-model-prefix: false
usage-statistics-enabled: false
disable-cooling: false
passthrough-headers: false
nonstream-keepalive-interval: 0
streaming:
  keepalive-seconds: 0
  bootstrap-retries: 0
claude-api-key:
  - api-key: "sk-claude-1"
    base-url: "http://<mock>/anthropic"
  - api-key: "sk-claude-2"
    base-url: "http://<mock>/anthropic"
codex-api-key:
  - api-key: "sk-codex-1"
    base-url: "http://<mock>/codex"
  - api-key: "sk-codex-2"
    base-url: "http://<mock>/codex"
gemini-api-key:
  - api-key: "sk-gemini-1"
    base-url: "http://<mock>/gemini"
  - api-key: "sk-gemini-2"
    base-url: "http://<mock>/gemini"
openai-compatibility:
  - name: "mockcompat"
    base-url: "http://<mock>/compat"
    api-key-entries:
      - api-key: "sk-compat-1"
      - api-key: "sk-compat-2"
    models:
      - name: "mock-gpt-4o"
        alias: "compat-gpt-4o"
      - name: "mock-reason"
        alias: "compat-reason"
